name: scene_batch_3
title: Card scenes, batch 3
intro: Keep or reject each scene, in the C and E mix. Each tile is the bare scene over two real cards, a program or event and a building, composed at 300 dpi with the full bleed showing: the program window is the whole scene, the building window its centre. Scenes are a pool: the card a scene was written for is a suggestion. The second card only shows the other window. For true size, print art-originals/scenes/b3/cards.pdf at 100%. Use the notes for what to change.

rows.label: 1. Industry: A half-finished bridge held up by temporary timber trestles, trucks already crossing over the gap.
rows.note: Written for Bridge Loan. Shown on Bridge Loan and Bonded Warehouse. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.
